purpose: Document the existing English and Tamil About-page openings for a compact bilingual website-preview study. This is not evidence of translation ownership, measured impact, photography authorship, or final official publication.

method.transport: TLS-verified Playwright APIRequestContext configured with environment HTTPS proxy; browser requests fulfilled from verified public responses. Certificate verification remained enabled.
method.authentication: None. Public source pages only. No form submitted.
method.framing: Opening-only screenshot clips within each browser viewport, excluding the lower commemorative mosaic and reference material. Exact clip dimensions are recorded per capture. No source DOM/CSS was changed.
method.selectedLanguage: Source route loaded directly; source language controls were not altered or simulated. Phone source Menu remained closed.

observations: Both matching About routes returned HTTP200.
Desktop headers link between English and Tamil versions of the About page.
The responsive phone header uses a Menu control.
The opening brand, navigation and About text change with the selected source language.
roleAttributionScope: Existing portfolio evidence identifies volunteer Social Media & Technology Head work since2023, including digital storytelling, social media and work on the organisation’s website. No claim of personally translating the content is made.
